message:
All tests now pass (2/2). The fix was in the test, not the code.

The failing assertion was `withVat(250)` expecting `301`. 250 pence plus 20% VAT is exactly 300 pence, and `Math.round(250 * 1.2)` returns 300. I changed the expected value in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300. I did not touch `src/vat.js`, because making it return 301 would mean adding a rounding rule that is wrong for this input.

If 301 was the intended business rule for some reason, say so and I'll look at the implementation instead. Otherwise nothing else needs changing.
